---
title: "Grading"
---

## Evaluation Breakdown

| Component | Marks |
|-----------|------:|
| Theory (3 modules × 23) | 69 |
| Laboratory (3 labs × 7) | 21 |
| Attendance | 10 |
| **Total** | **100** |

### Theory (69 marks)

- Module 1: 23 marks
- Module 2: 23 marks
- Module 3: 23 marks

Each module test evaluates conceptual understanding and problem-solving aligned with its corresponding module.

### Laboratory (21 marks)

Three lab evaluations at 7 marks each. Assessment includes: lab performance, code quality, viva/demo, submissions, and written quizzes.

### Attendance (10 marks)

Tracked through biometric system. Missing recorded attendance counts as absence. Students must ensure proper recording.

## Policies

**Leave requests:** There is no leave request system. Missed classes automatically count as absences regardless of reason.

**Exceptional circumstances:** Students missing 4+ consecutive classes may discuss emergencies with the instructor for possible special consideration, though exemptions are not guaranteed and require case-by-case evaluation.
